title: Length of the adjacency word
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A$ assign a Boolean value to each ordered pair of elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The list formed by concatenating, for each first coordinate in increasing order, the list of values of $A$ over all second coordinates in increasing order has length $n^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps each pair of elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to a Boolean value
